# Photographed surfaces

LAST LIGHT uses reduced-resolution WebP copies of the original color, OpenGL normal and packed ambient occlusion, roughness and metallic maps. The runtime adds room-specific color and wear. All four textures are [Poly Haven CC0 assets](https://polyhaven.com/license).

- Boiler room floor by Jenelle van Heerden. [Garage Floor](https://polyhaven.com/a/garage_floor).
- Boiler room block walls by Charlotte Baglioni. [Concrete Block Wall](https://polyhaven.com/a/concrete_block_wall).
- Office floor by Amal Kumar. [Terrazzo Tiles](https://polyhaven.com/a/terrazzo_tiles).
- Rooftop surfacing by Dimitrios Savva. [Tarred Gravel](https://polyhaven.com/a/tarred_gravel).
